CustomField.label: Assessment Tier
CustomField.description: Migration-readiness band derived from Assessment_Score__c at submission time, and the thing that decides what is sold: Discovery First (8-14, cannot responsibly scope yet), Prep Required (15-20, migratable once named prerequisites are met), Accelerator-Ready (21-26, standard engagement), Fast-Track (27-32, compressed / fixed-scope candidate). A HIGH score means a SMALL, SIMPLE, LOW-RISK estate -- not a sophisticated marketing operation. Two overrides apply on top of the band: a source_access answer of 1 caps the tier at Discovery First, and an unsupported source/target pair suppresses this field entirely (see Assessment_Advisory__c). Drives the readout template.
